essence: Needing nothing, helping all three worlds; desired of all, desiring nothing.
Good discernment sows endless-fruited love; great glamour slackens even treasure-holders.
Free doer alone amid all acts; seized worlds need none else's might or mercy.
Fault reaching you turns faultless; greed for you turns worshipful.
Contemplation-deed ennobles worm to Brahmā; beginnings, middles, ends are yours on thought's road.
No savour elsewhere matches love's nectar-liquor.

sections.SUMMARY: The helper wants nothing and feeds all, craved by each, craving none. Clear farmers plant undying affection; the conjuring veil makes even finders drowse. Every start permits, yet only one hand stays free; triple worlds drown till that hand or its kindness hauls out. Vice pointed at you inverts to virtue; clutching at you hallows clutching. One rite of minding you titles grub and godhead alike for freedom; alpha, fray, omega run on mind's lane yours. Beside your love-sap, all relish thins.

rasa.dominant: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)
rasa.justification: Help, harvest, hauling, hallowing: gifts moving both ways between Lord and lover, relished as nectar.
